examples.title: Example 1: Setting Data Panel Types
examples.description: This example shows how to set the data panel type using the type attribute of DataPanelOptions.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting Gradient Colors and Shadows
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set gradient colors and shadows using the valueColors and trackShadow for LinearGradient.

examples.title: Example 3: Disabling Animations and Shadows
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to disable animations and shadows using the closeEffect attribute.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Custom Content Area
examples.description: This example shows how to customize the content area of the data panel using the contentModifier API.
